ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In Figure 8, from 2000 to 2010, the line graph of grain output in Anhui Province is overall upward, indicating that grain output generally showed an upward trend; during the same period, the line graph of cultivated land area fluctuated and did not continuously increase. In Figure 9, the proportion of sown area of grain crops was 66.1% in 2000 and increased to 73.1% in 2010, indicating that the sown proportion of grain crops increased. Then reason: The stem asks “what support from the government”; among the main reasons given in the original question, both “policy support” and “scientific and technological support” may promote grain production increase, but the one that can directly correspond to “the government's ... support” is “policy support.” Therefore the answer is policy support.
